headlines.title: Anthropic IPO Draws 'Massive Enthusiasm' From Investors: Ludlow & Bloxham
headlines.summary: Anthropic priced a record-shattering $107.3 billion IPO — bigger than SpaceX — at $83 a share, above the marketed range, with gray markets pointing to a 20-26% first-day pop. This is the tape-defining event of the week: it either validates the AI spending boom or becomes the top-tick everyone talks about for years. Every AI-adjacent name from semiconductors to cloud infrastructure is moving on this print.

headlines.title: Fed's Waller says central bank may need to 'shock people' with half-point rate hike
headlines.summary: Fed Governor Waller floating a 50-basis-point hike is the kind of jawboning that moves the long bond and reprices every duration-sensitive asset on the board — equities, real estate, you name it. Coming on the same day the Fed minutes showed officials worried about AI-driven inflation, this is a one-two punch that could keep a lid on any Anthropic-IPO-fueled rally. Watch the two-year Treasury; that's where the real verdict gets rendered.

headlines.title: Walmart hikes outlook as top execs tell CNBC the retailer is gaining market share ahead of holidays
headlines.summary: Walmart raising guidance heading into the holiday stretch is a real-economy signal that cuts through all the AI noise — it tells you the consumer is still breathing. When the world's largest retailer says it's taking share, the whole consumer staples and discretionary complex has to reprice, and it gives the bulls a fundamental anchor beyond just chip stocks. This one moves WMT directly and sets the tone for Target and the rest of the retail tape.
